title: Localized pages vanished after canonical→.com → self-referencing canonicals, separate from hreflang
gate: 'localized pages vanished after canonical→.com' → self-referencing canonicals, canonical≠hreflang separate, reciprocity verified.
expected: Pointing a localized page's canonical at the global .com consolidates the localized pages away 'faster than robots.txt' — the single most destructive i18n SEO mistake. Each localized page's canonical must point to ITSELF; canonical and hreflang are separate elements. Treat the hreflang set as a graph with a CI check: every node self-references, every edge is reciprocal/bidirectional, codes are valid BCP-47, exactly one x-default.
mustRefuse: point canonical at the main site
add them to a sitemap and hope
